title: Auth Routes (login, register, refresh, me, setup)
goal: Create authentication API routes for login, registration, token refresh, current user, and first-time setup.
result_summary: Created POST /auth/login (returns JWT + refreshToken + agent), POST /auth/register (super_boss only, creates agents with role validation), POST /auth/refresh (token rotation), GET /auth/me (current user with permissions and hierarchy), POST /auth/setup (first-time super_boss creation when no agents exist). Registered auth routes in app.ts.
